title: Nutritious Polish Beef Casserole
description: A hearty and earthy Polish dish featuring beef cutlet, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal prep option. This casserole is filled with molten flavors and nutritious ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat and cook the beef strips until browned.
Add the sliced mushrooms, chopped onion, and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beef broth, tomato paste, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked beef and vegetable mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked brown rice.
Add the beef and vegetable mixture on top of the rice layer.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of rice on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
